case.title: Fe3GeTe2, field-driven reversal
case.reason: An itinerant metal with strong perpendicular anisotropy, cleanly uniaxial.
case.expectation: Uniaxial: the analytic optimal control path applies and the cost cannot beat the free-macrospin floor.

material.name: Fe3GeTe2
material.notes: Itinerant ferromagnet with strong perpendicular magnetic anisotropy. Moments and exchange from DFT plus Wannier plus TB2J (Ruiz 2024); the ordered moment is disputed between sources (1.82 average vs 2.64/1.47 per inequivalent Fe site), and that disagreement is propagated rather than hidden. Monolayer Tc falls to about 130 K. Damping is not firmly pinned in the literature reviewed; the band is wide on purpose.
